## A5. Scope — which stages does this request need?

Not every request needs all nine. Tick the stages in scope; untick the rest
and leave them unchecked in Part B.

- [ ] 3. S3 — Links

- [ ] 5. R2 — Segments
- [ ] 6. R3 — Keywords

- [ ] 9. T3 — Courses

## ✅ Intake Checklist — all must be ticked before Part B starts

- [ ] Requester and contact confirmed (A1)
- [ ] Source text identified and a usable copy is in hand (A2)
- [ ] Rights cleared and reviewing authority named (A3)
- [ ] Output, languages and deadline agreed (A4)
- [ ] Stages in scope agreed (A5)
- [ ] Definition of done agreed with the requester (A6)
